topics.label: Lecture introduction and overview of cancer hallmarks
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the learning outcomes, historical context, and overarching framework of cancer hallmarks and multistep mutation progression.

topics.label: Deregulation of growth signaling pathways
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how mutations in signaling cascades such as Wnt/beta-catenin and receptor tyrosine kinase pathways drive sustained cell proliferation and survival.

topics.label: Block in terminal differentiation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how cancer cells halt terminal lineage differentiation to maintain proliferative progenitor states in hematopoietic malignancies and intestinal epithelium.

topics.label: Evasion of apoptotic cell death
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details how cancer cells avoid programmed cell death through alterations in p53 regulation and the balance of mitochondrial pro- and anti-apoptotic proteins.

topics.label: Replicative immortality and cellular senescence
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how cancer cells overcome Hayflick limits through telomerase reactivation and bypass p53-mediated senescence to achieve continuous proliferation.

topics.label: Altered cellular metabolism and oncometabolites
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics analyze how cancer cells rewire metabolic pathways toward aerobic glycolysis and how metabolic enzyme mutations generate oncometabolites that alter gene expression.

topics.label: Induction of tumor angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the physiological trigger, balance of factors, and timing of new blood vessel recruitment required to sustain expanding tumor tissues.

topics.label: Mechanisms and biology of cancer metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the stepwise dissemination of cancer cells through circulation, factors influencing secondary site colonization, and genomic characteristics of metastases.

topics.label: Lecture summary and recommended reading
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer delivers concluding remarks summarizing the convergence of cancer hallmarks and recommends literature for advanced study.
